g.text: Preciazo - Design-Level Event Storming: Shopping Planning
US08: Create a list owned by the buyer.
If no name is supplied, use the current date and time.
US09: Add the requested product and quantity.
If already present, increase its quantity without duplicating it.
US10: Only a budget greater than zero is accepted.
Reject zero or negative amounts without changing the budget.
US11: Budget warning is calculated when Budget Status is queried.
With a defined limit: show warning if projected total > limit;
clear warning if projected total <= limit.
Query again after adding or removing an item, reducing quantity,
or defining or changing the budget.
The warning is derived read data:
no automatic command and no persisted warning event.
US12: Checkout total is the sum of purchased item amounts.
Marking adds the item amount; unmarking subtracts it.
Refresh Purchase Progress after either action.
Checkout total is separate from the projected total of all list items.
